extracted.name: Air-fried Fish fry 🐟
extracted.description: Try my homemade fish fry seasoning! Just a basic seasoning that can be used on any type of fish or shrimp
ingredient_lines: 1 tbs GOYA adoba seasoning (can sub for garlic & onion)
1 tbs smoked paprika (sub for regular paprika)
1/2 tbs Cajun seasoning (optional, sub for salt)
instruction_lines: Clean fish & prepare egg batter, flour, and dry seasonings in 3 separate containers.
Coat fish in flour, then egg batter, then seasoned breadcrumbs. Place on a cooling rack then repeat until all fish are coated
Let the fish rest. Preheat air fryer to 375 degrees and cook for 10 minutes, flip after 5 minutes, spray with oil for an extra crispy layer
If using an oven, preheat to 425, bake for 20 minutes, flip after 10
